div.style: margin: 0; padding: 0; width: 1440px; height: 900px; background: #0b0f19; color: #ffffff; font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif; overflow: hidden; display: flex; flex-direction: column;
display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; padding: 16px 40px; background: #121826; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08);
display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px;
background: linear-gradient(135deg, #10b981, #059669); color: white; font-weight: 800; font-size: 20px; padding: 8px 12px; border-radius: 8px;
display: flex; gap: 24px; font-size: 14px; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.7);

input.style: background: #0b0f19; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.15); padding: 8px 16px; border-radius: 20px; color: white; outline: none; width: 220px;

div.style: padding: 40px; flex: 1; overflow-y: auto;
background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.15), rgba(18, 24, 38, 0.8)); border: 1px solid rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.3); border-radius: 16px; padding: 40px; margin-bottom: 40px;
div.p: Handpicked premium browser games. No downloads, no signups—play instantly!

button.style: background: #10b981; color: white; border: none; padding: 12px 28px; font-weight: 600; border-radius: 8px; cursor: pointer; font-size: 14px;

h2.style: font-size: 20px; font-weight: 700; margin-bottom: 20px; border-left: 4px solid #10b981; padding-left: 12px;

div.style: display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr); gap: 20px;
